notes: The certificate section prints no outcomes of its own; the outcomes recorded are the Computer Information Systems program list, introduced as applying to 'the degree or certificate program', which this certificate appears to share. That list prints the same three outcomes twice (once without and once with labels); all six bullets are copied as printed.
The PDF prints codes with a stray space (e.g. 'CIS 1 13', 'CIS 1 16', 'CIS 1 19'); recorded as CIS 113, CIS 116, CIS 119.
The group block totals (Programming 3-4 units, User Support 3 units) read as choosing one course from the group; recorded as choose_courses 1. Reviewer should confirm.
Printed total 22-23 units does not match the sum of the printed parts (Required Core 16 + one group 3-4 = 19-20). Total recorded as printed.
CIS 120 and CIS 176 appear in the certificate requirements but not in the closed list; marked as catalog additions.
